title: Give the Model a Finger: Developmentally Aligned Evaluation of Counting in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 给模型一根手指：视觉语言模型计数的发育对齐评估

paragraphs.en: BabyVLM: Toward Developmentally Plausible Multimodal Systems
paragraphs.zh: BabyVLM：迈向符合发育规律的多模态系统

paragraphs.en: Vision–language models (VLMs) are exact on small sets and drift into estimation on larger ones, a profile reminiscent of children before they master counting. Children cross the barrier with epistemic actions: pointing at each item while reciting number words, moving counted items aside, partitioning the array. We give VLMs the same actions as dumb image tools with no visual intelligence of their own (a numbered tag at a coordinate, a zoom, an eraser, a grid) in a training-free agent loop. Our central claim is about measurement, not intervention: a model that counts by marking leaves a normally hidden serial procedure on the image, and the developmental principles of counting (used as measurement theory, not as a claim that VLMs are children) turn those marks into an interpretable audit of serial visual reasoning: every tag is classified against point-level ground truth as on-target, duplicate, phantom, or omitted (one-to-one correspondence), the answer is checked against the number of tags (cardinality), and order irrelevance is tested by forcing opposite traversal orders. Across 9 models, 682 images (a controlled dot-array battery; FSC-147, 8–80 objects; PixMo-Count, 2–10), and 7 harness conditions we find that (i) the exact-counting range is a model-specific signature spanning nearly two orders of magnitude ( R 80 R_{80} from 3 to 150 dots); (ii) as an intervention the finger mostly fails: tags help 4 of 9 models on small-count photographs (CI-solid for one), hurt imprecise pointers, and rarely beat a verbal routine or a blind point list; what the loop buys is an auditable trace, not accuracy; (iii) as measurement it succeeds: a tag-perturbation probe shows that precise pointers read their answers off the tags, pointing precision tracks which models benefit, dense scenes fail by omission (consistent with children’s keeping-track errors), and models rarely revise after seeing their own tags; and (iv) the capacities dissociate: models follow an instructed traversal order yet often change their answer when it reverses, beyond repeat and rotation controls, and children’s regular-over-scattered advantage appears only under the routine and survives lattices that defeat a rows-times-columns shortcut.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉—语言模型（VLM）在小集合上是精确的，而在更大的集合上则滑向估算，这一表现让人联想到尚未掌握数数的孩子。 孩子们通过认知性动作跨越这一障碍：一边背诵数词一边指点每个条目，把已数过的物品移到一边，对阵列进行划分。 我们把这些动作赋予VLM，作为本身没有任何视觉智能的“哑”图像工具（在坐标处打编号标签、缩放、橡皮擦、网格），并置于免训练的智能体循环中。 我们的核心主张关乎测量而非干预：一个通过打标记来计数的模型会把通常隐藏的串行过程留在图像上，而数数的发展原理（作为测量理论使用，而非主张VLM就是孩子）将这些标记转化为对串行视觉推理的可解释审计：每个标签都对照点级真值被分类为命中、重复、幻影或遗漏（一一对应），答案对照标签数量进行核查（基数性），并且通过强制相反的遍历顺序来检验顺序无关性。 在9个模型、682张图像（一个受控点阵测试集；FSC-147，8–80个物体；PixMo-Count，2–10个）和7种框架条件下，我们发现：(i) 精确计数范围是模型特有的标志，跨越近两个数量级（R_{80} 从3到150个点）；(ii) 作为干预手段，“手指”大多失效：标签仅在9个模型中的4个上对小计数照片有帮助（其中一个达到CI-solid），会伤害不精确的指针型模型，且很少胜过言语流程或盲目的点列表；这个循环所换来的是可审计的轨迹，而非准确率；(iii) 作为测量手段它是成功的：标签扰动探针显示，精确的指针型模型会照着标签读出答案，指点的精确度可以预示哪些模型受益，密集场景因遗漏而失败（与孩子的“保持追踪”错误一致），并且模型在看到自己的标签后很少进行修正；(iv) 这些能力是可分离的：模型会遵循被指示的遍历顺序，但在顺序反转时却常常改变答案，超出了重复和旋转控制的范围，而且儿童“规则排列优于散乱排列”的优势只在流程条件下出现，并能在击败“行乘列”捷径的格点上得以保持。

paragraphs.en: Ask a three-year-old how many crackers are on the table and, if there are two or three, the answer is immediate and exact. Ask about twelve and the child either guesses or starts to do something: touch each cracker in turn, say “one, two, three…”, slide the counted ones aside, and announce the last word as the total ( Gelman and Gallistel, 1978 ; Fuson, 1988 ; Wynn, 1990 ) . Two systems are at work: a fast, capacity-limited individuation of up to about four items ( subitizing , Kaufman et al., 1949 ; Trick and Pylyshyn, 1994 ) and an approximate sense of magnitude ( Feigenson et al., 2004 ; Xu and Spelke, 2000 ) . Exact enumeration beyond that range is a learned procedure that recruits the hands and the space around the child: pointing keeps items and number words in one-to-one correspondence ( Alibali and DiRusso, 1999 ; Saxe, 1977 ; Graham, 1999 ) , moving items aside and scanning row by row prevent double counts and skips ( Fuson, 1988 ; Potter and Levy, 1968 ; Beckwith and Restle, 1966 ) , and partitioning turns one big count into several small ones ( van Oeffelen and Vos, 1982 ) : epistemic actions , performed not to change the world but to make a computation easier ( Kirsh and Maglio, 1994 ; Kirsh, 1995 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 问一个三岁小孩桌上有几块饼干，如果只有两三块，答案会立刻且准确地说出来。 若问十二块，孩子要么瞎猜，要么开始动手：逐块摸饼干，嘴里念“一、二、三……”，把数过的拨到一边，最后念出的词就是总数（Gelman and Gallistel, 1978；Fuson, 1988；Wynn, 1990）。 这里有两种系统在起作用：一种是快速的、容量有限的个体化知觉，可精确感知至多约四个项目（即感数，subitizing，Kaufman et al., 1949；Trick and Pylyshyn, 1994）；另一种是对数量的近似感（Feigenson et al., 2004；Xu and Spelke, 2000）。 超出这个范围的精确计数是一种习得的程序，它借助双手和儿童周围的空间：用手指点使项目与数词保持一一对应（Alibali and DiRusso, 1999；Saxe, 1977；Graham, 1999），把项目拨开并逐行扫视可防止重复计数和遗漏（Fuson, 1988；Potter and Levy, 1968；Beckwith and Restle, 1966），而分块则把一次大计数变成几次小计数（van Oeffelen and Vos, 1982）：这些都是认知行动（epistemic actions），其目的不是改变世界，而是让计算变得更容易（Kirsh and Maglio, 1994；Kirsh, 1995）。

paragraphs.en: Vision–language models (VLMs) look strikingly like the pre-procedural child: near-perfect on one to four objects, sharply worse after that, systematically under-counting dense sets, erring like noisy estimators rather than enumerators ( Testolin et al., 2025 ; Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ; Che et al., 2026 ; Budny et al., 2025 ) , with the count present in the visual features but mis-read at the output ( Pang et al., 2026 ; El-Shangiti et al., 2026 ) . VLMs have a number sense but no counting routine. The claim is not that a VLM is a child or models one, but that the developmental account of counting supplies testable hypotheses (which external scaffolds should help) and diagnostic variables (what to measure when they do not).
paragraphs.zh: 视觉—语言模型（VLMs）看起来与程序前的儿童惊人地相似：在一到四个物体上近乎完美，之后急剧变差，对密集集合系统性地低估，其错误更像带噪声的估计器而非枚举器（Testolin et al., 2025；Tamarapalli et al., 2025；Che et al., 2026；Budny et al., 2025），且数量信息已存在于视觉特征中，却在输出处被误读（Pang et al., 2026；El-Shangiti et al., 2026）。 VLMs 具有数感，却没有计数程序。 我们并不是说 VLM 是儿童或对儿童建模，而是说计数的发展性解释提供了可检验的假设（哪些外部支架应当有帮助）以及诊断变量（当它们没有帮助时应测量什么）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask: if we give a VLM the epistemic actions that children use, does it count like a child who has learned to count, and does it fail like one? We build a training-free harness in which the model can draw a numbered tag at any image coordinate and see the tagged image, zoom into a region, grey out counted items, and overlay a coordinate grid. Every tool is a plain pixel operation with no detector, segmenter, or OCR behind it, so all perception and all decisions remain the model’s own; the harness only lends it a finger, a magnifier, and an eraser.
paragraphs.zh: 因此我们提出这样的问题：如果我们给一个视觉语言模型提供儿童使用的认知动作，它的数数是否像学会了数数的儿童，它的失败是否也像那样的儿童？ 我们构建了一个免训练的框架，模型可以在图像的任意坐标绘制一个带编号的标记并查看标注后的图像，放大某个区域，将已数过的项目变灰，以及叠加一个坐标网格。 每个工具都只是简单的像素操作，背后没有检测器、分割器或OCR，因此所有感知和所有决策都仍由模型自己完成；这个框架只是借给它一根手指、一个放大镜和一块橡皮擦。

paragraphs.en: The deeper contribution is measurement. A model that counts by marking externalises, mark by mark, a serial procedure that is normally hidden in its activations; the developmental principles of counting give that trace a grammar, turning model-generated marks into an interpretable audit of serial visual reasoning. This is what developmentally aligned evaluation adds over a benchmark score: not whether a model counts, but which constituent capacities it has, pointing, one-to-one tracking, cardinal read-out, checking, order invariance, each measured on its own. Following the classic analyses of children’s counting ( Gelman and Gallistel, 1978 ; Gelman and Meck, 1983 ; Fuson, 1988 ) , we classify every tag as on-target, duplicate, or phantom and every object as counted or omitted against point-level ground truth, test cardinality against the tags and order irrelevance by forcing opposite traversal orders, and measure pointing precision , on a controlled dot-array battery and two photographic benchmarks, FSC-147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) (8–80 dot-annotated instances) and PixMo-Count ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) (2–10).

sents.zh: 沿用对儿童计数的经典分析（Gelman and Gallistel, 1978；Gelman and Meck, 1983；Fuson, 1988），我们依据点级真值将每个标记分类为命中、重复或幻影，将每个对象分类为已计数或遗漏，将基数与标记进行核对，并通过强制相反的遍历顺序来检验顺序无关性，同时在受控点阵测试集和两个摄影基准上测量指点精度——FSC-147（Ranjan et al., 2021）（8–80 个点标注实例）和 PixMo-Count（Deitke et al., 2025）（2–10 个）。

(2) A training-free harness of dumb epistemic tools for counting, each mapped to a child strategy and a counting principle ( Section 3 ). (3) An empirical study over 9 models and 682 images with paired bootstrap uncertainty on every headline contrast ( Section 5 ), showing that the constituent capacities dissociate across models rather than forming one “counting ability” ( Table 2 ), and that the tools are diagnostic rather than therapeutic: a finger helps only models that can already point, and where it fails, the audit localises the missing prerequisite; the study costs under 153 US dollars, and all code, stimuli, and trajectories will be released.

paragraphs.en: Gelman and Gallistel (1978) described counting as governed by five principles: one-to-one (each item receives exactly one tag), stable order , cardinality (the last tag names the set size), abstraction (anything can be counted), and order-irrelevance . Children acquire number-word meanings slowly ( Wynn, 1990 ; Wynn, 1992 ; Le Corre and Carey, 2007 ; Sarnecka and Carey, 2008 ; Carey, 2009 ) , and even children who know the routine make keeping-track errors on large or disorganised arrays, skipping or double counting ( Fuson, 1988 ; Gelman and Meck, 1983 ) . Accuracy improves when children point at or touch each item ( Alibali and DiRusso, 1999 ; Graham, 1999 ; Saxe, 1977 ) , when the array is regular rather than scattered ( Potter and Levy, 1968 ; Beckwith and Restle, 1966 ) , and when large sets are counted in groups ( van Oeffelen and Vos, 1982 ) . Small sets are subitized ( Kaufman et al., 1949 ; Mandler and Shebo, 1982 ) , large sets estimated by an approximate number system shared with infants and animals ( Feigenson et al., 2004 ; Dehaene, 2011 ) ; number-sensitive units emerge spontaneously in deep networks ( Stoianov and Zorzi, 2012 ; Nasr et al., 2019 ; Testolin et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Gelman 和 Gallistel（1978）将计数描述为受五条原则支配：一一对应（每个项目恰好获得一个标签）、稳定顺序、基数性（最后一个标签指明集合的大小）、抽象性（任何东西都可以被计数）以及顺序无关性。 儿童对数词含义的习得十分缓慢（Wynn, 1990；Wynn, 1992；Le Corre and Carey, 2007；Sarnecka and Carey, 2008；Carey, 2009），即使已经掌握计数程序的儿童，在面对较大或排列无序的阵列时也会出现跟踪错误，发生漏数或重复计数（Fuson, 1988；Gelman and Meck, 1983）。 当儿童用手指点或触摸每个项目时（Alibali and DiRusso, 1999；Graham, 1999；Saxe, 1977）、当阵列排列规则而非散乱时（Potter and Levy, 1968；Beckwith and Restle, 1966），以及当较大的集合分组计数时（van Oeffelen and Vos, 1982），计数的准确性都会提高。 小集合可以被感数（subitize）（Kaufman et al., 1949；Mandler and Shebo, 1982），大集合则通过一个与婴儿和动物共享的近似数量系统来估计（Feigenson et al., 2004；Dehaene, 2011）；对数量敏感的单元会在深度网络中自发涌现（Stoianov and Zorzi, 2012；Nasr et al., 2019；Testolin et al., 2020）。

paragraphs.en: Counting benchmarks range from small sets ( Paiss et al., 2023 ; Deitke et al., 2025 ; Acharya et al., 2019 ) to dense scenes ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and in-the-wild or adversarial questions ( Tamarapalli et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . VLMs are accurate up to four or five objects and then degrade ( Testolin et al., 2025 ; Che et al., 2026 ) ; failure grows with overlap, occlusion, compositional structure, and prior-knowledge bias ( Rahmanzadehgervi et al., 2024 ; Pothiraj et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Vo et al., 2025 ) and tracks the serial demand that also slows humans ( Budny et al., 2025 ) . Remedies include count-aware training ( Paiss et al., 2023 ) , pointing supervision ( Deitke et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and point-then-count prompting ( Alghisi et al., 2026 ; Hou et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 计数基准涵盖从小型集合（Paiss 等，2023；Deitke 等，2025；Acharya 等，2019）到密集场景（Ranjan 等，2021），以及真实场景或对抗性问题（Tamarapalli 等，2025；Deng 等，2026）。 视觉语言模型在对象数量不超过四五个时较为准确，随后性能下降（Testolin 等，2025；Che 等，2026）；失败率随重叠、遮挡、组合结构以及先验知识偏差而增加（Rahmanzadehgervi 等，2024；Pothiraj 等，2025；Guo 等，2025；Vo 等，2025），并且与同样会拖慢人类的串行处理需求相关（Budny 等，2025）。 补救方法包括计数感知训练（Paiss 等，2023）、指点监督（Deitke 等，2025；Jiang 等，2026），以及先指点后计数的提示方法（Alghisi 等，2026；Hou 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Language models can call vision tools ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2025 ) , receive marks from a segmenter ( Yang et al., 2023 ) or a coordinate scaffold ( Lei et al., 2025 ) , or zoom into regions ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Closest to us, Autonomous Imagination ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , SketchVLM ( Collins et al., 2026 ) , point-then-count prompting ( Alghisi et al., 2026 ) , LVLM-Count ( Fetrat Qharabagh et al., 2024 ) , and ABACUS ( Mondal et al., 2026 ) let a model mark, cursor over, or tile the image, and treat the marks as an intervention or an explanation judged by task accuracy (positioning table in Table 4 ). We treat them as measurement : dumb pixel tools keep every mark the model’s own, and point-level ground truth decomposes the trace into omissions, duplicates, phantoms, and broken cardinality. The matching is standard (point-based crowd-localization metrics, Idrees et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Song et al., 2021 ; TIDE’s error taxonomy, Bolya et al., 2020 ); new are the loop that makes the marks and the principle tests that read them.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型可以调用视觉工具（Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023；Surís et al., 2023；Hu et al., 2024；Zhao et al., 2025；Su et al., 2025），从分割器（Yang et al., 2023）或坐标支架（Lei et al., 2025）接收标记，或放大图像区域（Wu and Xie, 2024；Shen et al., 2025；Zheng et al., 2025）。 与我们最接近的工作包括 Autonomous Imagination（Liu et al., 2025）、SketchVLM（Collins et al., 2026）、先点后数提示（point-then-count prompting，Alghisi et al., 2026）、LVLM-Count（Fetrat Qharabagh et al., 2024）和 ABACUS（Mondal et al., 2026），它们让模型做标记、悬停光标或对图像分块，并把标记视为一种干预或一种解释，以任务准确率来评判（定位结果见 Table 4 的表格）。 我们把它们视为测量手段：迟钝的像素工具使每个标记都保留为模型自己的产物，而点级真值将轨迹分解为遗漏、重复、幻影和基数错误。 这种匹配方法是标准的（基于点的密集人群定位指标，Idrees et al., 2018；Wang et al., 2021；Song et al., 2021；TIDE 的错误分类体系，Bolya et al., 2020）；新颖之处在于生成标记的循环以及读取这些标记的原理性测试。

paragraphs.en: Every tool is a pure PIL operation: the harness never detects, segments, recognises, or reads anything; it draws and crops what it is told, and the only intelligence outside the model is geometric bookkeeping (numbering and capping tags), so the study tests epistemic actions , not tool quality.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 (appendix) maps each tool to a child strategy and a principle. tag draws a dot at the requested coordinate and a numbered box beside it, the finger plus the number word (numbering continues across calls, so the harness supplies the stable order , which is scaffolded, not tested); crop returns an enlarged view with tags visible (leaning in); erase greys out counted objects (moving them aside); grid overlays a coordinate grid with 0–1000 ticks ( Lei et al., 2025 ) . A harness-driven tiles routine ( 2 × 2 2{\times}2 overlapping partition, one point-listing call per tile, geometric de-duplication in the overlap) mirrors counting by groups without any agency on the model’s side.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the loop: a system prompt fixes the tools, the coordinate frame, and a budget of T = 6 T{=}6 tool calls; each reply must end with one JSON action; after a tag call the verification prompt asks whether each tag sits on a distinct object, any object is untagged, or two tags share one, then to tag only the missing ones or answer. paragraphs.en: For every arm that produces points or tags and every image with point ground truth (DotArrays, FSC-147), we match tags to objects by minimum-cost assignment with a per-image distance threshold τ \tau (half the median nearest-neighbour distance among ground-truth points, floor 15 px). A matched tag is on-target ; an unmatched tag within τ \tau of an already-matched object is a duplicate (double count); an unmatched tag farther than τ \tau from every object is a phantom ; an unmatched object is an omission (skip). We report these per 100 ground-truth objects. Cardinality consistency is the fraction of trajectories whose announced count equals the number of tags; pointing error is the median, over images, of the per-image median distance between an on-target tag and its object, in thousandths of the shorter image side (DotArrays and FSC-147 pooled); abstraction and arrangement effects come from the DotArrays factor sets. Order irrelevance is tested directly: the tag loop is instructed to traverse the array left-to-right/top-to-bottom or the reverse; the realised traversal is read off the tag sequence, and the principle demands the same count either way (a same-order repeat control separates order dependence from inference instability). A 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} -rotation control counts the rotated image in reading order, which visits the objects in the reverse sequence under the natural instruction, separating order dependence from the difficulty of an unnatural scan; mirror consistency (same count on an image and its horizontal mirror) is a coarser invariance probe. Finally, a tag-perturbation probe asks whether the announced number is read off the tags at all: after the model’s first tag call the harness silently removes one on-target tag, or adds one on an untagged object, before returning the image. Sensitivity to τ \tau is reported in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个产生点或标签的分支（arm），以及每个带有点级真值的图像（DotArrays、FSC-147），我们通过最小代价指派并配合每张图像的距离阈值 τ \tau（真值点之间最近邻距离的中位数的一半，下限为 15 像素）将标签与对象匹配。 被匹配的标签为命中（on-target）；与某个已被匹配对象距离在 τ \tau 之内的未匹配标签为重复（double count，即重复计数）；与所有对象距离都超过 τ \tau 的未匹配标签为幻影（phantom）；未匹配的对象为遗漏（omission，记为 skip）。 我们以每 100 个真值对象为单位报告这些指标。 数量一致性（cardinality consistency）是所宣布的计数等于标签数量的轨迹所占比例；指点误差（pointing error）是各图像中命中标签与其对象之间距离的中位数再在图像上取中位数，以图像短边的千分之一为单位（DotArrays 与 FSC-147 合并计算）；抽象与排布效应来自 DotArrays 的因子集。 顺序无关性受到直接检验：标签循环被指示按从左到右/从上到下遍历阵列，或按相反顺序遍历；实际遍历顺序从标签序列中读出，而该原则要求两种方式得到相同计数（同序重复对照将顺序依赖与推理不稳定性区分开来）。 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} 旋转对照在阅读顺序下对旋转后的图像计数，在自然指令下这会以相反顺序访问各对象，从而将顺序依赖与非自然扫描的难度区分开；镜像一致性（图像与其水平镜像得到相同计数）是一个更粗粒度的不变性探测。 最后，标签扰动探测检验所宣布的数字是否真的是从标签上读出的：在模型的第一次标签调用之后，测试框架在返回图像之前悄悄移除一个命中标签，或在一个未被标注的对象上添加一个标签。 对 τ \tau 的敏感性报告见附录 E。

sents.en: Cardinality consistency is the fraction of trajectories whose announced count equals the number of tags; pointing error is the median, over images, of the per-image median distance between an on-target tag and its object, in thousandths of the shorter image side (DotArrays and FSC-147 pooled); abstraction and arrangement effects come from the DotArrays factor sets.
sents.zh: 数量一致性（cardinality consistency）是所宣布的计数等于标签数量的轨迹所占比例；指点误差（pointing error）是各图像中命中标签与其对象之间距离的中位数再在图像上取中位数，以图像短边的千分之一为单位（DotArrays 与 FSC-147 合并计算）；抽象与排布效应来自 DotArrays 的因子集。

sents.en: Order irrelevance is tested directly: the tag loop is instructed to traverse the array left-to-right/top-to-bottom or the reverse; the realised traversal is read off the tag sequence, and the principle demands the same count either way (a same-order repeat control separates order dependence from inference instability).
sents.zh: 顺序无关性受到直接检验：标签循环被指示按从左到右/从上到下遍历阵列，或按相反顺序遍历；实际遍历顺序从标签序列中读出，而该原则要求两种方式得到相同计数（同序重复对照将顺序依赖与推理不稳定性区分开来）。

sents.en: A 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} -rotation control counts the rotated image in reading order, which visits the objects in the reverse sequence under the natural instruction, separating order dependence from the difficulty of an unnatural scan; mirror consistency (same count on an image and its horizontal mirror) is a coarser invariance probe.
sents.zh: 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} 旋转对照在阅读顺序下对旋转后的图像计数，在自然指令下这会以相反顺序访问各对象，从而将顺序依赖与非自然扫描的难度区分开；镜像一致性（图像与其水平镜像得到相同计数）是一个更粗粒度的不变性探测。

sents.en: Finally, a tag-perturbation probe asks whether the announced number is read off the tags at all: after the model’s first tag call the harness silently removes one on-target tag, or adds one on an untagged object, before returning the image.
sents.zh: 最后，标签扰动探测检验所宣布的数字是否真的是从标签上读出的：在模型的第一次标签调用之后，测试框架在返回图像之前悄悄移除一个命中标签，或在一个未被标注的对象上添加一个标签。

Dense photographs (FSC-147). No tool arm moves any model reliably: the largest tag gains (Qwen3-VL-32B +7.0 pp, Qwen3-VL-8B +6.0 pp) carry CIs that span zero, the rest are flat or slightly worse, and verbal chain of thought is the strongest single intervention for Flash-Lite (41.0 %, +18.0 pp [+7,+29]). Dot arrays. The success stories of Figures 6 and 7 (appendix) are real but not the average: Flash-Lite moves from 36.0 to 58.0 % ( tag+crop ; tag +14.0 pp [+4,+26]) and its counting range from R 80 = 7 R_{80}{=}7{} to 20, but every other model is flat (Gemini 3.1 Pro) or loses, CI-solidly so for GPT-5 mini (-30.0 pp), Grok 4.20, Grok 4.5, and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Table 8 ). paragraphs.en: Table 2 gives each model’s capacity profile with bootstrap intervals (per dataset and arm: Figures 9 and 11 ), and Figure 4 (appendix) plots each model’s gain from tagging against its pointing error. (i) Pointing precision is the prerequisite. The median on-target tag lands 1.6 thousandths of the image side from its object for Gemini 3.7 Flash and 5.1 for Flash-Lite, but 34.1 for Grok 4.20 and 40.4 for GPT-5 mini; the imprecise pointers add 31.9–52.7 phantom tags per 100 objects ( Table 2 ) and are exactly the models that lose accuracy with the tag loop. (ii) In dense scenes the routine breaks by omission. For the models that can point, the dominant residual on FSC-147 is skipping (38.1 omissions per 100 objects for Flash-Lite, 28.7 for Gemini 3.1 Pro), then phantoms; duplicates are rare (4.4 and 1.8), as in children, who lose their place more often than they double count. (iii) Models rarely revise after looking: only 17.2 % of Flash-Lite trajectories issue a second tag call (46.7 % for Gemini 3.1 Pro): one-shot tagging without the checking step children learn. (iv) Cardinality is mostly respected (93.0 % of Flash-Lite and 100.0 % of Gemini 3.1 Pro trajectories on DotArrays announce exactly the number of tags), but the imprecise pointers decouple the two (66.9 % for GPT-5 mini): they tag, distrust the tags, and estimate anyway. Since no tool deletes a tag, a departure from the tag count may be a correction, and mostly is (closer to the truth in 83 % of cases; Table 19 ). (v) The answer is read off the tags, not the tags off the answer. A model could estimate a number and draw that many points; two tests say the precise pointers do not. paragraphs.en: Children count regular arrays more accurately than scattered ones ( Potter and Levy, 1968 ) . Figure 5(b) (appendix) shows a qualitatively analogous ordering for models once they count with tags (regular > > random > > clustered; Flash-Lite: 90.3/79.2/70.8 %), whereas direct estimation shows no advantage for regular arrays (51.4/58.3/66.7 %): the arrangement effect is a signature of the routine, not of the number sense. Two controls rule out a rows-times-columns shortcut ( Tables 22 and 23 ). The lattices are jittered and the tags follow the jitter: Flash-Lite’s on-target tags land 3.3 px from the dot but 14.1 px from the cell centre, with tag and dot offsets correlated at r = 0.86 r{=}0.86{} (0.99 for Gemini 3.7 Flash), so the marks sit on dots, not on an imagined grid. On new hexagonal and holed lattices, which offer no product to recite, Flash-Lite’s tag advantage persists (85 and 90 % against 55 % on random arrays of the same n n ) but Qwen3-VL-8B’s does not (25/25 vs. 25 %), and a lattice rotated by 20–40 ∘ is hard for every model and arm (30 % under tag ): for the one model with a working routine the regular advantage is that of an organised scan path, which a rotated lattice no longer offers in reading order. Abstraction: mixed shapes and red-among-blue sets cost direct more than the tag arms ( Table 17 ).

paragraphs.en: Instructed to tag the same 68 arrays in opposite traversal orders, models follow the procedure (tag order tracks the instructed scan, Table 9 ). The principle behind the procedure fares worse: the two traversals end in the same count on 44 % of arrays for Flash-Lite and 24 % for Qwen3-VL-32B, against 86 % for Gemini 3.7 Flash. Two controls separate order dependence from other causes ( Table 9 ). Repeating the same order agrees on 65/40/87 % of arrays, so reversal adds +21.7 pp (CI [+14,+31]) and +15.4 pp ([+8,+23]) of disagreement beyond inference instability for the mid-tier models and none for Gemini 3.7 Flash (+0.7 pp). Because the reverse scan is simply harder (Flash-Lite drops from 60 to 47 %), a rotation control counts each array rotated by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} in ordinary reading order, visiting the dots in reverse under the natural instruction at undiminished accuracy (63 %); it still disagrees with the unrotated runs +9.6 pp (CI [+1,+18]) more often than the repeat control for Flash-Lite (+0.0 pp for Gemini 3.7 Flash): part of the raw reversal effect was difficulty, but an order effect remains. paragraphs.en: Table 14 varies the harness on the ablation subset for the two tier-1 models with usable pointing. Removing the verification prompt raises Flash-Lite’s accuracy (39.9 to 45.5 %), not because the checked arm adds tags (it draws no more and re-tags less often, 27 vs. 38 %) but because, asked whether any object is still untagged, the model re-estimates verbally instead of re-inspecting: it announces more than it tagged in 13 % of trajectories against 6 % without the prompt, and is then right only 17 % of the time. Plain marks match numbered tags on accuracy but lower cardinality consistency; the grid is the most useful addition (45.5 %); erase , crop , and the turn budget hardly matter. Strict seriality ( tag-1 , one point per look, T = 80 T{=}80 ; Table 10 ) changes the errors more than the accuracy (Flash-Lite 51.5 vs. 54.4 %): phantoms collapse (6.1 vs. 21.6 per 100 objects) and the failure becomes abandoning the traversal (Gemini 3.7 Flash leaves 67.9 % untagged yet answers well), at 12–15 × \times the cost; batching is not what breaks the routine, and the batched trace is a fair record of it.

paragraphs.en: Both a VLM and a pre-procedural child have a serviceable approximate number sense and no reliable serial routine, so the same external scaffolds can help or fail to help both. Pointing helps only if pointing is precise: children whose gestures are not yet coordinated with their number words gain less from gesturing ( Alibali and DiRusso, 1999 ) , and neither do our imprecise pointers ( Table 2 ). Two failures our audit quantified, answers that come apart from the tags and the missing habit of checking one’s count, have close parallels in preschoolers ( Gelman and Meck, 1983 ) . Two parts do not transfer: children practise and internalise the routine, whereas our models neither learn from the tags nor carry the routine to the next image (a prosthesis, not a curriculum); and the model’s “motor” error is a coordinate-prediction error without proprioceptive feedback, hence the outsized effect of the coordinate frame and the grid.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）与接受程序前测试的儿童都具备可用的近似数感和缺乏可靠的串行例程，因此相同的外部脚手架既能帮助两者，也可能对两者都无效。 只有当指认足够精确时，指认才有帮助：手势尚未与数词协调一致的儿童从手势中获益较少（Alibali and DiRusso, 1999），我们那些指认不精确的智能体也是如此（表 2）。 我们审计所量化的两类失败——答案与标签脱节、以及缺少核对计数的习惯——在学龄前儿童中都有紧密的对应现象（Gelman and Meck, 1983）。 有两个方面无法迁移：儿童会练习并内化该例程，而我们的模型既不从标签中学习，也不会把例程延续到下一张图像（这是一种假体，而非课程）；并且模型的“运动”错误是在没有本体感受反馈下的坐标预测错误，因此坐标系与网格才产生了如此巨大的影响。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.7 Flash’s verbal cliff (CoT R 80 = 80 R_{80}{=}80{} against 150, Figure 2 ) looks backwards only if chain of thought is a count. Past about 80 dots it is not: of the 30 CoT replies at n ≥ 80 n\geq 80 , the 6 that tally row by row are all exact, whereas the other 24 partition the image into regions, estimate each, and add the estimates, which is exact 8 times and under-counts by -7.2 on average. A verbal routine has no external record, so beyond the span it can tally in text it falls back on the approximate system applied piecewise, whose under-counting bias accumulates, a verbal analogue of children’s keeping-track failures ( Fuson, 1988 ) ; the answer-only arm, free to spend hidden reasoning ( Appendix G ), and the tag loop, which externalises the record, degrade more slowly. A routine helps only while its bookkeeping holds, and external marks extend it. Three levers follow from the audit: calibrate pointing (a grid helped), train the verification step (the current prompt makes the model re-estimate rather than re-inspect), and combine the verbal and visual routines.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 的言语悬崖（思维链 R 80 = 80 R_{80}{=}80，对比 150，见图 2）只有在把思维链当作计数时才显得是退步。 超过约 80 个圆点后情况并非如此：在 n ≥ 80 n\geq 80 的 30 条思维链回复中，逐行清点的 6 条全部精确，而另外 24 条把图像分区、逐一估计再相加，这种方法精确 8 次，平均少计 -7.2。 言语例程没有外部记录，因此一旦超出其能以文字清点的范围，它便退回到分段使用的近似系统，其少计偏差不断累积，这相当于儿童计数中“跟不上趟”失败的言语版本（Fuson, 1988）；仅给答案组可以自由消耗隐藏推理（附录 G），标签循环则将记录外化，二者退化得更慢。 例程只有在簿记能维持时才有帮助，而外部记号可以延长它的有效期。 从本次审查可得出三个改进杠杆：校准指点（网格有所助益）、训练验证步骤（当前的提示让模型重新估计而非重新查看），以及将言语例程与视觉例程相结合。

paragraphs.en: All models are accessed through one API at temperature 0 with low reasoning effort; direct is answer-only rather than reasoning-free, two endpoints could not have reasoning disabled ( Table 21 ), and Qwen3-VL-32B was withdrawn by the provider during revision. The dot-array battery is deliberately simple, the photographic sets cover only 8–80 and 2–10 objects, FSC-147 dots mark approximate centres, so tags on elongated objects can be scored as phantoms ( τ \tau -sensitivity in Appendix E ). Finally, the developmental alignment is in the evaluation : our claims are qualitative correspondences with the child literature, not psychometric fits, and all subjects are frozen general-purpose VLMs; running the battery on models trained on child-scale data, and asking whether they could acquire the routine rather than borrow it, is the natural next step.

paragraphs.en: Dumb tools let one mid-tier VLM count fifty dots exactly where it used to guess, and left most others flat or worse. The lasting contribution is what the marks make visible: read through the developmental principles of counting, a wrong count becomes a diagnosis — imprecise pointing, lost track, an unchecked answer, an order-dependent count. Can a model learn the routine, and the habit of checking it, as children do?
paragraphs.zh: 笨拙的工具让一个中等水平的视觉语言模型在它过去只能瞎猜的场景中精确数出五十个点，而大多数其他情况则持平甚至更差。 持久的贡献在于这些标记让什么变得可见：通过计数的发展原理来解读，一个错误的计数就成了一项诊断——指点不精确、丢失进度、未核验答案、依赖顺序的计数。 模型能否像儿童那样学会这套流程，以及核验它的习惯？

paragraphs.en: For each image with point ground truth we form the distance matrix between the model’s tags (pixel coordinates of the exact tag points) and the ground-truth points, and solve a minimum-cost one-to-one assignment (Hungarian algorithm) in which pairs farther apart than a per-image threshold τ \tau are forbidden. τ \tau is half the median nearest-neighbour distance among the ground-truth points of that image, floored at 15 px; the median τ \tau is 44 px on DotArrays (range 17–272, wide because sparse arrays have large nearest-neighbour distances) and 41 px on FSC-147 (range 15–138). A matched tag is on-target ; an unmatched tag within τ \tau of some (necessarily already-matched) object is a duplicate ; an unmatched tag farther than τ \tau from every object is a phantom ; a ground-truth point left unmatched is an omission . Scaling τ \tau inside an image cannot create matches beyond one per object, so duplicates and omissions are conservative with respect to τ \tau ; the phantom/duplicate boundary is the sensitive one.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个有点级真值标注的图像，我们在模型的标记（精确标记点的像素坐标）与真值点之间构建距离矩阵，并求解一个最小成本的一对一分配问题（匈牙利算法），其中距离超过该图像阈值 τ \tau 的配对被禁止。τ \tau 取该图像真值点之间最近邻距离中位数的一半，且下限为 15 像素；τ \tau 的中位数在 DotArrays 上为 44 像素（范围 17–272，范围较宽是因为稀疏阵列具有较大的最近邻距离），在 FSC-147 上为 41 像素（范围 15–138）。 被匹配的标记为命中；与某个（必然已被匹配的）目标距离在 τ \tau 之内的未匹配标记为重复；与所有目标距离都超过 τ \tau 的未匹配标记为幻影；未被匹配的真值点为遗漏。 在图像内部缩放 τ \tau 无法使每个目标产生多于一个匹配，因此重复和遗漏对 τ \tau 是保守的；敏感的是幻影与重复之间的边界。

paragraphs.en: The two order arms are the standard tag loop with one sentence appended to the first user message requesting a left-to-right/top-to-bottom or a right-to-left/bottom-to-top traversal (verbatim in Appendix B ); Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Qwen3-VL-32B, and Gemini 3.7 Flash ran both arms on the 68 DotArrays images of the ablation subset. Because tags are numbered in the order they are drawn, the realised traversal is observable: τ ¯ \bar{\tau} in Table 9 is the Kendall correlation between tag index and vertical position, averaged over trajectories with at least five tags. Order irrelevance predicts identical final counts under the two traversals; agreement below the model’s own exact accuracy on these arrays means the traversal, which should be irrelevant, changes the answer. Because hosted models are not perfectly deterministic even at temperature 0, each order arm was run twice: the repeat control in Table 9 measures how often the same order repeated yields a different count (averaged over both orders), the cross agreement averages over all four pairs of opposite-order runs, and the order effect is their difference, so the three columns are consistent by construction. The rotation control runs the reading-order arm on every array rotated by 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} (twice; Qwen3-VL-8B replaces the withdrawn Qwen3-VL-32B), which visits the dots in the reverse sequence under the natural instruction; its agreement is averaged over the four pairs of (unrotated, rotated) reading-order runs and its effect is again the excess over the repeat control.
paragraphs.zh: 两个顺序组（order arms）是标准的标签循环，在第一条用户消息中追加一句话，要求按从左到右/从上到下或从右到左/从下到上的顺序遍历（原文见附录 B）；Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite、Qwen3-VL-32B 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash 在消融子集的 68 幅 DotArrays 图像上运行了这两个组。 由于标签是按绘制顺序编号的，实际发生的遍历是可观测的：表 9 中的 τ ¯ \bar{\tau} 是标签索引与垂直位置之间的 Kendall 相关系数，在至少含五个标签的轨迹上取平均。 顺序无关性预测两种遍历下的最终计数完全相同；若一致性低于模型自身在这些数组上的精确准确率，则说明本应无关的遍历改变了答案。 由于托管模型即使在温度为 0 时也不完全具有确定性，每个顺序组运行了两次：表 9 中的重复对照衡量相同顺序重复运行产生不同计数的频率（对两种顺序取平均），跨一致性对全部四组相反顺序的运行对取平均，而顺序效应是二者之差，因此三列在构造上是一致的。 旋转对照将阅读顺序组在每幅旋转 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} 的数组上运行（各两次；Qwen3-VL-8B 替代了已撤回的 Qwen3-VL-32B），在自然指令下这会以相反顺序访问各点；其一致性是对四组（未旋转，旋转）阅读顺序运行对取平均，其效应同样是对重复对照的超额部分。

paragraphs.en: The batched tag call can place many points before the model sees any of them rendered, so the standard trace is an ordered externalised enumeration, not proof of item-by-item inspection. The tag-1 arm closes that gap: each call may add exactly one point (extra points are discarded with a notice), so every mark is placed only after the previous one is observed. Table 10 compares direct , batched tag , and tag-1 for the two precise pointers on the DotArrays ablation images.
paragraphs.zh: 批量标签调用可以在模型看到任何点被渲染之前放置许多点，因此标准轨迹是一种有序的外化枚举，而不是逐项检查的证明。 标签-1（tag-1）方案弥补了这一差距：每次调用只能添加一个点（多余的点会被丢弃并给出提示），因此每个标记都只在上一个标记被观察到之后才会放置。 表 10 在 DotArrays 消融图像上对两种精确指针比较了 direct、批量标签（batched tag）和标签-1（tag-1）。

paragraphs.en: A model could estimate a number first and then draw that many points, in which case the tags would record the answer rather than produce it. Table 19 tests this on every image that ran both direct and tag : how often the number of tags equals the model’s own direct answer, and how the per-image tag-count error correlates with the direct error. On PixMo-Count the two agree often because both are usually right; on the dense photographs of FSC-147 the tag count equals the direct answer on only 10–53 % of images. The right-hand columns show that departures of the announced count from the tag count are mostly corrections: the announced number is then closer to the truth in 83 % of trajectories pooled over models. Table 20 reports the causal version of the test, the tag-perturbation probe of Section 4 : after the model’s first tag call the harness removes one on-target tag or adds one tag on an untagged object, renumbers, and returns the altered image with the usual verification message, so that only the model’s own emission disagrees with what it sees. A model that reads its tags should notice (re-tag the missing object, or start over) or at least announce the visible number; a model that estimates and then draws should announce the number it emitted. The precise pointers do the former: Gemini 3.7 Flash re-tags the removed object in nearly every dot-array trajectory, Flash-Lite in most, and both announce the visible number. GPT-5 mini repairs least often. Qwen3-VL-8B announces the visible number in every trajectory yet seldom repairs: it reads the count off the tags without checking them, which is its cardinality consistency of 95.1 % seen from the other side.
paragraphs.zh: 模型可以先估计一个数字，然后画出相应数量的点，在这种情况下，标签将只是记录答案而不是产生答案。 表 19 在所有同时运行了直接计数和打标签的图像上对此进行测试：标签数量与模型自身直接给出的答案相等的频率，以及每张图像的标签数量误差与直接计数误差的相关性。 在 PixMo-Count 上两者经常一致，因为二者通常都是正确的；而在 FSC-147 的密集照片上，标签数量仅在 10–53 % 的图像上与直接答案相等。 右侧的列表明，所报出的数量与标签数量之间的偏差大多是修正：在汇总所有模型的轨迹中，所报出的数字在 83 % 的情况下更接近真实值。 表 20 报告了该测试的因果版本，即第 4 节的标签扰动探测：在模型的第一次打标签调用之后，测试框架移除一个目标物体上的标签，或在某个未打标签的物体上添加一个标签，重新编号，并返回带有常规验证消息的修改后图像，使得只有模型自身的输出与它所看到的内容不一致。 一个真正读取其标签的模型应该会注意到（为缺失的物体重新打标签，或者重新开始），或者至少报出可见的数量；而一个先估计再绘制的模型则应报出它所输出的数字。 具备精确指针能力的模型做到了前者：Gemini 3.7 Flash 在几乎每一个点阵轨迹中都为被移除的物体重新打标签，Flash-Lite 在大多数轨迹中也是如此，而且两者都会报出可见的数量。 GPT-5 mini 修复的频率最低。 Qwen3-VL-8B 在每条轨迹中都报出可见的数量，却很少进行修复：它直接从标签上读出数量而不加以检查，这正是从另一个角度看到的其 95.1 % 的基数一致性。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 reports the hidden reasoning tokens that the provider returns for the single-turn arms, and the thinking-off control: the direct prompt rerun with reasoning disabled (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, GPT-5 mini) or set to the minimal effort the endpoint accepts (Gemini 3.7 Flash, whose endpoint, like Gemini 3.1 Pro’s, refuses to disable reasoning). paragraphs.en: Every API call logs the provider-reported cost (OpenRouter usage.cost ), so the accounting below is measured, not estimated. The whole study, roughly 67,000 calls over 29,000 trajectories (E1 across nine models, the ablation grid, the mirror-flip, traversal-order, repeat-control, and strict-seriality experiments, and the XL extension, including pilots and reruns), cost 153.13 US dollars. The three tier-1 models, which ran all seven arms on all 652 images, account for about one third of the total; the frontier and contrast models on the 240-image common subset and the XL extension account for most of the rest. Table 25 lists, per model, the OpenRouter identifier, the list prices, the mean cost per image for each arm, and the total spend. Two observations: the tool loop multiplies cost by roughly 3 × 3\times over direct for the cheap models (more calls, re-sent images) but remains below one US cent per image for every tier-1 model; and the cost–accuracy frontier of Figure 4 (right) is driven almost entirely by the model, not by the arm.

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 shows one representative trajectory for each of five automatically mined categories (final working images re-rendered from the stored actions; the selection script scans all tag / full trajectories with point ground truth). Fixed : the tag loop corrects a wrong direct answer. Duplicates : several tags pile onto already-counted objects, typically in tight clusters. Phantoms : tags land on background or between objects, the signature failure of imprecise pointers, which often follows a degenerate coordinate sequence (evenly spaced points marching across the image). Omissions : whole regions are left untagged, the dominant failure in dense scenes. Cardinality : the announced count differs from the number of drawn tags, i.e. the model tags, then distrusts its tags and estimates. The counts of mined candidates per category ( tag and full over DotArrays and FSC-147) were 325, 81, 1815, 529, and 399 trajectories respectively, so phantoms are by far the most common tag-level pathology in this study.
paragraphs.zh: 图 12 展示了五个自动挖掘类别中每个类别的一条代表性轨迹（最终工作图像由存储的动作重新渲染；筛选脚本扫描所有带有点级真值的 tag / full 轨迹）。 Fixed（已修正）：tag 循环纠正了一个错误的直接答案。 Duplicates（重复）：多个 tag 堆叠在已被计数的对象上，通常出现在紧密的簇中。 Phantoms（幻影）：tag 落在背景或对象之间，这是不精确指针的标志性失败，通常跟随一个退化的坐标序列（在图像上匀速行进的等间距点）。 Omissions（遗漏）：整个区域未被标注，这是密集场景中的主要失败模式。 Cardinality（数量不一致）：宣布的计数与绘制的 tag 数量不同，即模型先标注，然后不信任自己的 tag 并进行估计。 每个类别挖掘出的候选轨迹数量（tag 和 full 在 DotArrays 和 FSC-147 上）分别为 325、81、1815、529 和 399 条轨迹，因此幻影是本研究中最常见的 tag 级别病理性失败。
